recipes.title: Soupe à l'Oignon Gratinée
recipes.description: Classic onion soup with melted Gruyère cheese over toasted bread — an iconic Parisian comfort dish.

ingredients.name: large onion, sliced into thin rings

instructions: Heat butter and olive oil in a deep pot over medium heat. Add the onion and mix.
Cook the onion over low heat for about 40 minutes until it turns a deep caramel brown, stirring occasionally. Add sugar after 20 minutes.
Raise the heat, add white wine and scrape the remains of caramelization from the bottom of the pot.
Add beef stock, bay leaves and thyme. Bring to a boil, reduce to a low heat and cook for 20 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
Toast the baguette slices in the oven at 200 degrees until lightly browned.
Divide the soup into ovenproof bowls, place slices of toasted bread and generously sprinkle with Gruyère cheese.
Put in the grill until the cheese is bubbling and golden. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Vichyssoise
recipes.description: Creamy leek and potato soup served cold — an elegant dish for summer days.
instructions: Melt butter in a pot, add leek and fry over low heat for about 5 minutes until softened, without burning.
Add potatoes and chicken stock. Bring to a boil and cook for about 25 minutes until the potatoes are soft.
Grind in a blender until a completely smooth texture is obtained. Strain through a fine sieve to obtain a silky texture.
Add cream, season with salt and white pepper. Mix and put in the fridge for at least 4 hours.
Serve on cold plates, with a spoonful of crème fraîche and chopped chives on top.

recipes.title: Coq au Vin
recipes.description: Chicken braised in red wine with mushrooms and pearl onions — a classic Burgundy dish.
instructions: Soak the chicken pieces in red wine overnight in the refrigerator with herbs.
Remove the chicken from the wine, dry well and season. Save the wine.
Heat oil in a heavy pot, fry the bacon until crispy. Take out and keep.
Sear the chicken in a pot until browned on all sides. Take out and keep.
In the same pot, fry pearl onions and carrots for about 5 minutes. Add garlic and tomato paste and mix for a minute.
Return the chicken and bacon, add the reserved wine, stock and boca grani. Bring to a boil.
Cover and transfer to an oven heated to 160 degrees. Cook for an hour and a half.
In the last 20 minutes, fry mushrooms in butter until golden and add to the pot.
Removed from the oven. If the sauce is thin, transfer to the stove and thicken with mixed butter and flour.
Serve with mashed potatoes or rustic bread.

recipes.title: Ratatouille
recipes.description: Provençal vegetable stew with eggplant, zucchini, and bell peppers — summery and colorful.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a wide pan. Fry eggplant until golden on all sides. Take out and keep.
Add more oil, fry zucchini and peppers until slightly softened. Take out and keep.
In the same pan, fry the onion for about 5 minutes. Add garlic and tomato paste, mix for a minute.
Add chopped tomatoes and thyme. Cook for about 10 minutes until a thick sauce is formed.
Return all the fried vegetables to the pot, mix gently. Cover and cook on low heat for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper. Serve with torn fresh basil leaves on top.

recipes.title: Quiche Lorraine
recipes.description: Savory tart with cream, eggs, and bacon in crispy crust — a classic from Lorraine.
instructions: Heat the oven to 190 degrees. Pour the dough into a quiche pan (24 cm), prick the base with a fork.
Cover the dough with baking paper and weights (dry beans). Bake for 15 minutes, remove weights and bake for another 5 minutes.
Fry bacon in a dry pan until crispy and golden. Strain off the fat.
Beat eggs with cream, milk, nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Sprinkle bacon and Gruyère cheese on the base of the baked dough. Pour the egg mixture on top.
Bake for 35-40 minutes until the quiche is golden and firm in the center. Let rest 10 minutes before cutting.

recipes.title: Croissant
recipes.description: Buttery layered pastry in a crescent shape — the ultimate French breakfast.
instructions: Mix flour, sugar, salt and yeast. Add lukewarm milk and 30 grams of butter. Knead for 8 minutes until a smooth dough.
Wrap in cling film and put in the fridge overnight (8-12 hours).
Form the 280 grams of butter into a flat square (15x15 cm) between two layers of baking paper. Return to the refrigerator.
Roll the dough into a rectangle, place the square of butter in the center and fold the dough around it.
Go down to a long rectangle, make a triple fold (into three). Wrap and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Repeat the process two more times.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of 4 mm. Cut long triangles (base 10 cm, height 20 cm).
Roll each triangle from the base to the edge. Shape into a crescent shape and place on a lined baking sheet.
Let rise at room temperature for about two hours until doubled in size. Apply egg mixture.
Bake in an oven heated to 200 degrees for about 15-18 minutes until golden and crispy.

recipes.title: Madeleine
recipes.description: Small shell-shaped sponge cakes with lemon and vanilla — delicate and buttery.
instructions: Beat eggs and sugar well for about 5 minutes until the mixture is light and fluffy.
Add lemon zest, lemon juice and vanilla extract.
Sift flour, baking powder and salt. Gently fold into the egg mixture.
Add melted butter in a thin stream while gently folding. Cover and refrigerate for at least an hour.
Heat the oven to 200 degrees. Place and flour a madeleine mold.
Fill each cavity up to ¾. Bake for 10-12 minutes until springy in the center (the famous boss) and the edges are golden.
Remove from the mold immediately, cool on a wire rack. Excellent with powdered sugar on top.

recipes.title: Crème Brûlée
recipes.description: Vanilla custard topped with caramelized sugar crust — an iconic French dessert.
instructions: Heat the oven to 150 degrees. Heat the cream with the vanilla seeds and the pod until it first boils, remove from the heat.
Beat egg yolks with sugar until the mixture is light. Don't beat it too much.
Pour the hot cream in a thin stream over the yolk mixture while stirring constantly. Sanno
Divide into ramekins (6 units). Place in a deep baking dish and fill hot water up to half the height of the ramekins.
Bake for 40-45 minutes until the cream is firm on the edges but still slightly wobbly in the center.
Cool and then refrigerate for at least 4 hours (preferably overnight).
Before serving, sprinkle a teaspoon of sugar on each ramekin and burn with a burner flame until a crispy caramel layer.

recipes.title: Tarte Tatin
recipes.description: Upside-down caramelized apple tart — a rustic French classic.
instructions: Heat the oven to 190 degrees. Peel apples, cut into quarters and remove the seeds.
In an ovenproof pan (26 cm), melt sugar over medium heat until an amber caramel is formed. Add butter and mix.
Arrange the apple quarters densely on the caramel, some standing up. Add lemon juice.
Cook on the stove for about 15 minutes until the apples begin to soften and the caramel deepens in color.
Cover the pan with a sheet of puff pastry, fold the edges inward. Poke a few holes.
Bake for 25-30 minutes until the dough is golden and puffy.
Remove from the oven, wait 5 minutes. Carefully turn over on a serving plate - the caramel will come out on top.
Serve warm with a scoop of vanilla ice cream or whipped cream.

recipes.title: Beurre Blanc
recipes.description: Classic white butter sauce with shallots and white wine — perfect for fish.

ingredients.name: Very cold butter, cut into cubes

instructions: In a small saucepan, combine shallot, white wine and vinegar. Cook over medium heat until the liquid is reduced to about 2 tablespoons.
Reduce to very low heat. Start adding cubes of cold butter one by one, whisking constantly.
Each cube of butter must be melted before adding the next one. The sauce should be creamy — not separated.
When all the butter has been absorbed, strain the sauce, season with salt, white pepper and lemon juice.
Serve immediately over grilled fish, salmon or seafood. Do not reheat.

recipes.title: Vinaigrette Classique
recipes.description: Classic French salad dressing with Dijon mustard and vinegar — simple and flavorful.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix mustard, vinegar, salt and honey until the salt dissolves.
Add olive oil in a thin stream while constantly whisking until the sauce emulsifies and becomes slightly thick.
Mix the chopped shallot and black pepper.
Taste and adjust seasoning. Can be kept in a closed jar in the refrigerator for up to a week. Shake before use.

recipes.title: Bouillabaisse
recipes.description: Traditional Provençal fish stew with aromatic herbs and saffron — a Mediterranean coastal treasure.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a wide pot. Fry onions and fennel for about 5 minutes. Add garlic and stir for a minute.
Add tomatoes, tomato paste, orange peel and saffron. Cook for 5 minutes.
Add 1.5 liters of water, bring to a boil and cook for 20 minutes to create a rich base.
Add the large pieces of fish first. After 5 minutes add shrimp and mussels.
Cook another 5-8 minutes until the mussels open and the fish is ready. Remove unopened clams.
Season with salt and pepper. Serve in deep bowls with croutons and roi (garlic mayonnaise) on the side.

recipes.title: Bisque de Homard
recipes.description: Creamy lobster bisque with cognac — a luxurious seafood soup.
instructions: Melt butter in a heavy saucepan. Burn the lobster skeletons on high heat for about 5 minutes until they turn red.
Add onion, carrot and celery. Fry for 5 minutes. Add tomato paste and mix.
Add cognac (caution - may get excited). Add white wine and reduce by half.
Add fish stock, bring to a boil and cook for 30 minutes on low heat.
Grind in a blender (including the skeletons), filter through a fine sieve while pressing hard to extract all the flavor.
Return to the pot, add cream. Heat gently, season with salt and cayenne pepper. Serve with a dollop of cream.

recipes.title: Soupe au Pistou
recipes.description: Provençal vegetable soup with fresh basil pesto — vibrant and summery.
instructions: In a large pot, bring 2 liters of water to a boil. Add white beans and potatoes, cook for 15 minutes.
Add zucchini, green beans and tomatoes. Cook another 10 minutes.
Add pasta and cook until pasta is al dente (about 10 minutes).
Meanwhile, prepare pesto: grind basil, garlic, parmesan and olive oil in a food processor until smooth pesto.
Season the soup with salt and pepper. Serve in bowls with a heaping spoonful of pesto in the center.

recipes.title: Potage Parmentier
recipes.description: Simple leek and potato soup — comforting and homey.
instructions: Melt butter in a pot. Fry the leek over low heat for about 5 minutes until it softens.
Add potatoes and stock. Bring to a boil and cook for about 25 minutes until tender.
Grind in a stick blender until you get a smooth texture. Add cream.
Heat gently, season with salt and pepper. Serve with chopped chives and a drizzle of olive oil.

recipes.title: Bœuf Bourguignon
recipes.description: Beef stew in red wine with vegetables and bacon — the ultimate French comfort food.

ingredients.name: Beef for stew (short ribs or brisket), cut into cubes

instructions: Soak the meat in red wine with chopped carrots and Bocca Grani overnight in the refrigerator.
Strain, keep the wine. Dry the meat well. Heat the oven to 160 degrees.
Fry bacon in a heavy pot until crispy. took out Sear the meat in portions until brown.
Fry pearl onions and carrots for 5 minutes. Add garlic and tomato paste, mix for a minute.
Sprinkle flour over the vegetables and mix. Add the reserved wine, stock and Boca Grani.
Return the meat and bacon. Bring to a boil, cover and transfer to the oven for 2.5 hours.
In the last 30 minutes, fry mushrooms in butter and add to the pot.
Serve with mashed potatoes or wide egg noodles.

recipes.title: Cassoulet
recipes.description: Hearty white bean casserole with duck, sausage, and pork — a winter warmer from Languedoc.
instructions: Cook the beans soaked in water for about 45 minutes until softened but not falling apart. Sanno
Burn the lamb in a heavy pot. took out Fry sausages until golden, cut into slices.
Fry onion and garlic for 5 minutes. Add crushed tomatoes, stock and boca grani. Boil for 10 minutes.
In a deep casserole dish, arrange layers: beans, lamb, sausages, duck legs. Pour the sauce on top.
Sprinkle with breadcrumbs. Bake in the oven at 150 degrees for about 2.5 hours. Every half hour, break the resulting crust and press in.
Serve when the top is crispy and golden and the stew is bubbling.

recipes.title: Escargots de Bourgogne
recipes.description: Burgundy snails with garlic herb butter — an iconic French appetizer.
instructions: Make garlic butter: mix soft butter with garlic, parsley, shallot, salt and pepper until a uniform mixture.
Heat the oven to 200 degrees. Filter the snails and dry with a paper towel.
Place each snail in the cavity of a special snail mold (or ramekins). Cover each with a heaping spoonful of garlic butter.
Bake for 10-12 minutes until the butter bubbles and starts to turn golden.
Serve immediately with slices of baguette to soak up the glorious butter.

recipes.title: Blanquette de Veau
recipes.description: Veal in creamy white sauce with mushrooms and pearl onions — a delicate and refined dish.
instructions: Place the veal cubes in a pot of cold water. Bring to a boil, whip the foam.
Add carrot, bocca grani, salt and white pepper. Cook on low heat for 75 minutes until the meat is tender.
Take out meat and carrots. Filter and save the stock.
In a clean pot, melt butter, add flour and mix for 2 minutes (white roux). Gradually add 600 ml stock.
Cook pearl onions and mushrooms in sauce for 10 minutes. Return meat and carrots.
Mix cream with egg yolks and lemon juice. Add to the pot off the heat while stirring (do not boil).
Serve immediately with white rice or egg noodles.

recipes.title: Confit de Canard
recipes.description: Duck leg slow-cooked in its own fat until melt-in-your-mouth tender — a southwestern French delicacy.
instructions: A day in advance: rub the duck legs with coarse salt, garlic, thyme and pepper. Cover and refrigerate 12-24 hours.
Wash the shins from salt, dry well. Heat the oven to 130 degrees.
Melt the duck fat in a saucepan. Dip the shanks completely in the fat.
Add bay leaves, cover tightly and transfer to the oven. Cook for 3 hours until the meat separates from the bone.
To serve: remove from the fat, sear in the fat in a pan over high heat until the skin is crispy and golden.
Serve with potatoes sautéed in duck fat and a green salad.

recipes.title: Steak Frites
recipes.description: Grilled steak with French fries — a French bistro classic.
instructions: Cut potatoes into sticks. Soak in water for 30 minutes, dry well.
Fry at 140 degrees for 6 minutes (first cooking). Take out and cool.
Heat a cast iron pan until smoking. Season steak with salt and pepper. Sear for 3 minutes on each side (medium-rare).
Add butter, garlic and thyme. Drizzle the bubbling butter over the steak for 30 seconds.
Transfer to a plate, cover and let rest for 5 minutes. Meanwhile, fry fries again at 190 degrees until golden and crispy.
Serve steak with fries and salt and pepper. On the side - Maradotel butter or Barnez sauce.

recipes.title: Moules Marinières
recipes.description: Mussels in white wine with shallots and parsley — a bistro favorite.
instructions: Clean the clams: Discard any open clams that do not close with a squeeze. Removed bristles.
In a wide pot, melt butter. Fry shallot and garlic for 2 minutes on medium heat.
Add white wine, bring to a boil. Add all the clams, cover immediately.
Cook for 4-5 minutes, shaking the pot occasionally, until all the oysters open.
Discard unopened oysters. Sprinkle with parsley and pepper. Serve in deep bowls with chips and bread.

recipes.title: Gratin Dauphinois
recipes.description: Creamy potato gratin from the Dauphiné region — rich and indulgent.
instructions: Heat the oven to 170 degrees. Put a baking tray in butter and rub with garlic.
Heat cream and milk with garlic, salt, pepper and nutmeg until the first boil.
Arrange overlapping layers of potatoes in the pan. Every few layers, pour a little cream mixture.
Pour the remaining cream on top until it covers the top layer.
Bake for 60 minutes until the top is golden and the potatoes are soft (test with a knife).
Let rest 10 minutes before serving. Perfect as a side dish to roast meat.

recipes.title: Salade Niçoise
recipes.description: Tuna salad with eggs, olives, and vegetables from Nice — fresh and satisfying.

ingredients.name: Fresh tuna steak (or a can of quality tuna)

instructions: If using fresh tuna: sear 2 minutes on each side on a high pan. Spread into slices.
Arrange lettuce leaves on a large serving platter.
Arrange in groups: sliced ​​potatoes, green beans, square eggs, tomatoes, olives and anchovies.
Place the tuna in the center.
Make a vinaigrette: mix olive oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper. Drizzle over the salad. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Croque-Monsieur
recipes.description: Grilled ham and cheese sandwich with béchamel — a Parisian café classic.

ingredients.name: Slices of brioche bread or pen de mi

instructions: Prepare in a quick way: melt 15 grams of butter, add flour, mix for a minute. Add milk gradually until a thick sauce. Season with nutmeg.
Spread mustard on 2 slices of bread. Lay ham and cheese. Cover with the second slice.
Spread evenly on the top of each sandwich. Sprinkle grated Gruyere on top.
Bake in an oven heated to 200 degrees (or grill) for about 10 minutes until golden and bubbly.
Serve immediately with a green salad on the side.

recipes.title: Pot-au-Feu
recipes.description: Traditional beef and vegetable stew — France's national dish.

ingredients.name: Dijon mustard and pickle to serve

instructions: Place meat and bones in a large pot of cold water. Bring to a slow boil, whip the foam thoroughly.
Add burnt onion, bocca grani, peppercorns and salt. Reduce to very low heat.
Cook for 2 hours. Add carrot, leek, turnip and celery. Cook for another hour.
Take out the meat, spread into thick slices. Arrange vegetables on the side.
Filter the broth. Serve in two stages: first the stock as a soup, then the meat and vegetables with mustard and pickles.

recipes.title: Crêpe Complète
recipes.description: Buckwheat crepe with ham, cheese, and egg — a Breton specialty.
instructions: Make the batter: mix spelled flour, water, egg and salt until a smooth consistency. Bitter for an hour.
Heat a large flat pan (or carpier). Spread thin butter.
Pour a ladleful of batter and swirl to form a thin crepe. Cook for 2 minutes until the bottom is golden.
Place a slice of ham, sprinkle with cheese and break an egg in the center.
Cover for 2 minutes. Fold the edges inward to form a square with the egg in the center. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Baguette Tradition
recipes.description: Classic French white bread with crispy crust and airy crumb — the symbol of French bakery.
instructions: Mix flour, water, salt and yeast. Knead for 10 minutes until the dough is flexible and smooth (the window test).
First rise: cover and rise for 2 hours at room temperature, folding every 45 minutes.
Divide into 3 equal parts. Form each part into a ball, cover and let rest for 20 minutes.
Form each ball into a long (55 cm) baguette shape by rolling and gently stretching.
Place on a floured cloth or baguette pan. Cover and let rise for 45 minutes.
Heat an oven to 250 degrees with a pan of water at the bottom (for steam). Score 5 diagonal slits in each baguette.
Bake for 20-25 minutes until the crust is dark golden and the bread sounds hollow when tapped.

recipes.title: Pain au Chocolat
recipes.description: Flaky pastry filled with dark chocolate batons — a beloved afternoon treat.
instructions: Prepare a layered dough just like a croissant: knead, overnight in the refrigerator, 3 triangular folds with butter.
Roll the dough into a 4 mm thick rectangle. Cut 8x15 cm rectangles.
Place a chocolate bar at one end, roll, place a second bar, continue rolling. Place on a pan, seam down.
Let rise for about two hours at room temperature. Apply egg mixture.
Bake at 200 degrees for 15-18 minutes until golden and puffy. The chocolate must be melted.

recipes.title: Brioche
recipes.description: Rich sweet bread enriched with butter and eggs — soft and golden.
instructions: Mix flour, sugar, salt and yeast. Add eggs one by one while kneading. Knead for 10 minutes until elastic.
Add soft butter gradually (cube by cube) while kneading. Dough must be smooth and shiny.
Cover and let rise for two hours. Fold, cover and refrigerate overnight.
The next day, divide into 10 balls. Form a brioche a tet (a small ball over a large one) in greased brioche molds.
Leave for an hour. Spread an egg. Bake at 180 degrees for 25-30 minutes until golden. Cool on a wire rack.

recipes.title: Fougasse
recipes.description: Provençal flatbread with olive oil and herbs — rustic and aromatic.
instructions: Mix flour, water, yeast, olive oil and salt. Knead for 8 minutes. Fold in olives and rosemary.
First rise for about an hour and a half until the dough has doubled in size.
Roll out on baking paper in an oval shape (1 cm thick). Make cuts in a leaf pattern and stretch to open.
Swell for another 30 minutes. Apply olive oil and sprinkle with crystalline salt.
Bake at 220 degrees for 18-20 minutes until golden and crispy. Serve lukewarm.

recipes.title: Gougères
recipes.description: Savory cheese puffs made with choux pastry — perfect appetizers.
instructions: Heat the oven to 190 degrees. Bring water, butter and salt to a boil.
Remove from heat, add flour all at once. Mix vigorously until the dough separates from the sides.
Heat on low heat for a minute (to dry). Transfer to a bowl. Add eggs one by one while mixing.
Fold in 60 grams of gruyere, pepper and nutmeg.
Squeeze small balls from a syringe onto a lined pan. Pesaro Gruyere remains above.
Bake for 22-25 minutes until puffed and golden. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Palmier
recipes.description: Caramelized puff pastry cookies shaped like palm leaves — crispy and sweet.
instructions: Heat the oven to 200 degrees. Sprinkle sugar on the work surface.
Roll the puff pastry over the sugar into a rectangle. Sprinkle sugar on top as well.
Roll the two long sides towards the center until they meet.
Cut slices 1 cm thick. Place on a lined baking sheet with space between them.
Bake for 8 minutes, flip, bake for another 5-7 minutes until caramelized and golden on all sides.

recipes.title: Galette Bretonne
recipes.description: Buckwheat crepe from Brittany — savory and traditional.
instructions: Beat butter and sugar until light cream. Add egg yolks one by one.
Sift flour and baking powder, fold into the mixture. Wrap and refrigerate for an hour.
Roll out to a thickness of 1 cm. Cut circles (diameter 6 cm). Place on a lined baking sheet.
Apply egg yolk mixture, draw lines with the tines of a fork. Cool for 15 minutes.
Bake at 180 degrees for 12-15 minutes until golden. Cool on a wire rack.

recipes.title: Macarons
recipes.description: Delicate almond meringue cookies with cream filling — colorful and sophisticated.
instructions: Sift almond flour and powdered sugar together twice. Mix with half of the egg whites and food coloring.
Make syrup: heat sugar and water to 118 degrees. Pour in a stream on the second half of the egg whites while whipping (Italian meringue).
Beat until the meringue reaches room temperature. Fold into the almond mixture in gentle movements (macronage).
Squeeze a round syringe (3 cm) onto a lined pan. Tap the pan. Dry for 30-45 minutes until a crust forms.
Bake at 150 degrees for 13-15 minutes. When the macarons are firm and have 'legs' (mouth) - they are ready.
Ganache: heat cream, pour over chopped chocolate, mix until smooth. Cool until thick.
Pair macaroons of similar size, fill ganache between them. Chill in the fridge 24 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Profiteroles
recipes.description: Choux pastry filled with ice cream and drizzled with hot chocolate sauce — a show-stopping dessert.
instructions: Bring water, butter, salt and sugar to a boil. Add flour all at once, mixing until the dough separates.
Cool for 2 minutes, add eggs one by one. The dough must be smooth and shiny.
Squeeze a syringe of balls (diameter 3 cm) on a mold. Bake at 200 degrees for 22-25 minutes until swollen and golden.
Turn off the oven, open the door a little. Leave 10 minutes to dry.
Make a sauce: heat cream, pour over chopped chocolate, mix until smooth.
Cut each shoe in half, fill with a scoop of vanilla ice cream. Arrange on plates, drizzle hot chocolate sauce on top.

recipes.title: Éclair au Chocolat
recipes.description: Choux pastry filled with cream and topped with chocolate glaze — a French patisserie staple.
instructions: Make sho dough: boil water and butter, add flour, mix. Cool, add eggs one by one.
Squeeze a finger syringe (12 cm) on a mold. Bake at 200 degrees for 25-30 minutes. Cool completely.
Cream: heat milk. Beat egg yolks with sugar and cornflour. Pour hot milk, return to the heat, cook until thick.
Add 150 grams of chopped chocolate to the hot cream, mix until smooth. Cover with cling film and refrigerate.
Fill the eclairs with cream through 3 holes at the bottom using a nozzle.
Frosting: heat cream with 100 grams of chocolate. Dip the top of each eclair. Refrigerate until it hardens.

recipes.title: Mousse au Chocolat
recipes.description: Light and airy chocolate mousse — elegant and decadent.
instructions: Melt chocolate with butter in a bain-marie. Cool to room temperature.
Add egg yolks one by one to the chocolate while mixing.
Beat egg whites with salt until stiff. Add sugar gradually and continue to beat.
Fold a third of the egg whites into the chocolate (to lighten the texture). Gently fold the rest in two steps.
Divide into cups. Refrigerate for at least 4 hours. Serve with whipped cream or chocolate flakes.

recipes.title: Tarte au Citron Meringuée
recipes.description: Lemon tart with crispy pastry and tangy filling topped with meringue — bright and refreshing.
instructions: Pour dough into a tart pan (24 cm). Pierce and blind bake at 180 degrees for 20 minutes.
Lemon cream: heat lemon juice, zest, sugar and eggs in a bain-marie while stirring until it thickens (80 degrees).
Remove from heat, add butter cube by cube while stirring. Filter and pour into the baked dough. Refrigerate for an hour.
Meringue: beat egg whites until stiff, add sugar gradually. Continue whisking for 5 minutes.
Cover the lemon cream with meringue using a star nozzle. Flame in the burner until golden. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Mille-Feuille
recipes.description: Thousand-layer pastry with pastry cream and icing — a classic French dessert.
instructions: Roll out puff pastry to a thickness of 3 mm. Pierce densely. Bake between 2 pans at 200 degrees for 18-20 minutes until golden and flat.
Crème pâtissier: heat milk with vanilla. Beat egg yolks, sugar and cornflour. Combine, cook until thick.
Add butter, cover tightly and refrigerate.
Cut dough into 3 equal rectangles. Apply a thick layer of cream on the first, cover with the second, cream, third layer.
Glaze: mix powdered sugar with a teaspoon of water. Apply on the top layer. Draw lines in chocolate, draw with a knife.
Refrigerate for an hour. Cut with a sharp serrated knife. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Soufflé au Chocolat
recipes.description: Chocolate soufflé that rises dramatically — impressive and decadent.
instructions: Heat the oven to 200 degrees. We put ramekins in butter and covered with sugar (important for rising!).
Melt chocolate with butter in a bain-marie. Cool a little. Add egg yolks one by one.
Beat egg whites until soft, add sugar gradually, continue until medium stiff.
Fold a third of the egg whites into the chocolate. Gently fold in the rest—don't overmix!
Fill ramekins to the brim. Slide with a knife. Run a finger around the rim (to form a 'hat').
Bake for 12-14 minutes. The souffle should rise 3-4 cm above the ramekin, with a quivering center. Serve within 30 seconds!

recipes.title: Clafoutis aux Cerises
recipes.description: Cherry custard cake from Limousin — rustic and homey.
instructions: Heat the oven to 180 degrees. We put a baking pan in butter.
Spread the cherries in one layer in the pan.
Blender: grind eggs, sugar, flour, milk, cream and vanilla until a smooth batter.
Pour the batter over the cherries.
Bake for 30-35 minutes until puffed and golden, with the center still slightly quivering.
Sprinkle powdered sugar and serve lukewarm. The calphoti will fall a little - that's natural.

recipes.title: Île Flottante
recipes.description: Floating island - soft meringue floating on vanilla custard — light and elegant.
instructions: Beat egg whites until stiff, add 100 grams of sugar gradually. Continue whisking for 3 minutes.
Heat milk to a gentle boil. Form large meringue domes and soak them in milk for 2 minutes on each side. Remove to a plate.
Crème anglaise: beat egg yolks with 80 grams of sugar. Pour the hot milk gradually while stirring.
Return to the pot on low heat, mix with a wooden spoon until the cream thickens (82 degrees). Do not boil! Sanno
Add vanilla. Cool and refrigerate. Pour into deep plates.
Place a meringue dome on each plate. Make caramel from 80 grams of sugar and pull thin strings on top. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Crêpes Suzette
recipes.description: Thin pancakes in orange butter sauce flambéed with Grand Marnier — theatrical and delicious.
instructions: In the batter: mix flour, eggs, milk and melted butter until smooth. Bitter 30 minutes.
Bake thin crepes in a greased pan (about 8 crepes). Fold each into a quarter.
Sauce: melt butter in a pot, add sugar and caramelize until amber. Add orange juice and zest.
Place the folded crepes in the sauce. Heat for 2 minutes, pour sauce over them.
Add Grand Marnier. Tilt the pan to create a flame (or light it with a match). Serve immediately when the flames die down.

recipes.title: Paris-Brest
recipes.description: Choux pastry ring filled with praline cream — named after the Paris-Brest bicycle race.
instructions: Make sho dough: boil water and butter, add flour, mix. Cool, add eggs one by one.
Squeeze a large ring (diameter 24 cm) on a lined baking sheet. Sprinkle sliced ​​almonds.
Bake at 200 degrees for 25-30 minutes until puffed and golden. Cool completely.
Praline mousseline cream: beat soft butter until fluffy. Gradually fold in pastry cream and praline spread.
Cut the ring across. Fill with cream using a star nozzle.
Cover the top, sprinkle with powdered sugar. Refrigerate 30 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Sauce Béchamel
recipes.description: Classic white sauce with milk and butter — one of the five mother sauces.
instructions: Melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Add flour and mix for 2 minutes (white roux). Don't tan.
Add cold milk gradually, about a third at a time, whisking constantly to prevent lumps.
Keep stirring until the sauce thickens and coats the back of the spoon (about 5 minutes).
Season with nutmeg, salt and white pepper. Filter if there are lumps.
Use immediately, or cover tightly with cling film to prevent a crust.

recipes.title: Sauce Velouté
recipes.description: Smooth sauce made with white stock — a versatile mother sauce.
instructions: Melt butter in a pot. Add flour and mix for 3 minutes until the mixture turns blond (sand color).
Add light stock gradually while whisking constantly.
Bring to a gentle boil. Cook for 20 minutes on low heat, stirring occasionally, until the sauce coats a spoon.
Drain, season with salt and white pepper. Cream can be added to create a supreme sauce.

recipes.title: Sauce Espagnole
recipes.description: Rich brown sauce — a foundational mother sauce.
instructions: Sauté vegetables (from herbs) in butter until hot and brown, about 8 minutes.
Add flour and mix for 5 minutes until a dark roux (chestnut brown) is formed. Caution - do not burn.
Add tomato paste, mix for a minute. Add beef stock gradually while whisking.
Add Boca Grani. Bring to a boil and cook over very low heat for two hours, whisking occasionally.
Filter through a fine sieve. Season with salt and pepper. For demi-glace - reduce by half.

recipes.title: Sauce Hollandaise
recipes.description: Creamy butter and egg yolk sauce — essential for eggs Benedict.
instructions: Beat egg yolks with a teaspoon of water in a bain-marie bowl (over boiling water, not touching the water).
Beat non-stop for 3-4 minutes until the egg yolks thicken and double in volume.
Remove from heat. Add clarified butter in a very thin stream while whisking constantly.
When all the butter has been incorporated, add lemon juice, salt and cayenne pepper.
Serve immediately. Do not reheat - the sauce will fall apart.

recipes.title: Sauce Tomate
recipes.description: Classic French tomato sauce — a fundamental mother sauce.

ingredients.name: Ripe tomatoes (or a can of crushed tomatoes)

instructions: Melt butter, fry onion and carrot for 5 minutes on medium heat. Add garlic and tomato paste, mix.
Add tomatoes, stock, sugar and boca grani. Bring to a boil.
Reduce to a low heat, cook for 40 minutes uncovered until the sauce thickens.
Remove Boca Garni. Grind smooth or leave a rustic texture.
Season with salt and pepper. Suitable for pasta, meat, fish or as a base for other sauces.
